  "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below true outcomes, showing 1-3 euro lag/undershoot throughout all 5 examples",
    "Bias is most severe in early forecast horizons (days 1-10) where model misses by 0.5-2.0 euros",
    "Middle horizons (days 11-20) show better alignment but still maintain 0.5-1.5 euro divergence",
    "Extended horizons (days 21-30) exhibit greatest divergence ranging from 1.0 to 3.0 euros",
    "Sentiment positivity correlates with model undershoot - high sentiment (≥0.67) regions show largest gaps between forecast and reality",
    "When sentiment turns negative (-0.33 to -1.00), model forecasts overshoot actual prices by 0.5-2.0 euros",
    "Mean reversion bias exists as model fails to account for the true price level anchoring to recent historical ranges"
  ]
}
